product_brief: Crypto-agile Cryptographic Next Generation (CNG) provider for Microsoft Windows enabling post-quantum security and compliance.
pqc_support: Yes — Supports NIST FIPS204 MLDSA, FIPS205 SLHDSA, XMSS, LMS, hybrid combinations, and country-specific standards.
pqc_capability_description: The provider enables seamless integration of customized post-quantum algorithms into the Windows platform. It supports NIST FIPS204 MLDSA and FIPS205 SLHDSA certificates, other NIST PQC algorithms like XMSS and LMS, hybrid classical/PQC combinations, and country-specific standards (MySEAL, KpqC, NGCC). It integrates with hardware (smartcards, USB tokens, HSMs, TEEs) and quantum technologies (QRNG, QKD). Partners include PQShield (FIPS 140-3 certified PQCryptoLib-Core) and Feitian Technologies.
crypto_primitives: ML-DSA (FIPS 204), SLH-DSA (FIPS 205), XMSS, LMS, Hybrid classical and post-quantum algorithms, MySEAL, KpqC, NGCC
architecture_type: CNG Provider for Microsoft Windows; integrates with smartcards, USB tokens, HSMs, and TEEs
fips_validated: FIPS 140-3 certified implementations available via partner PQShield (PQCryptoLib-Core); pQCee supports certified implementations under FIPS140 CMVP
pqc_roadmap_details: Collaboration with PQShield and Feitian Technologies to integrate cryptographic modules; live demonstration at RSAC Conference 2026
qkd_protocols_&_quantum_networking: Integration with Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) mentioned, but specific protocols not stated
qrng_&_entropy_sources: Integration with Quantum Random Number Generators (QRNG) mentioned, but specific types or compliance not stated
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Partnerships with PQShield and Feitian Technologies for cryptographic module integration
